command: for k in 0..4: .papercusp/scratch/p013-a/run-matrix.sh <k> <k>, i.e. P013_MATRIX=1 P013_MODES=warm,cold P013_CONCURRENCIES=1,8 P013_WARMUPS=20 P013_WARM_SAMPLES=200 P013_COLD_SAMPLES=50 P013_REPETITIONS=1 P013_REPETITION_OFFSET=<k> P013_DEDICATED_PG=native P013_FIXTURE_EMBEDDER=1 npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/blueprint/operation-performance.integration.test.ts
summary: Workload A graded PASS 9/9 D-016 bars on the median of five clean repetitions (200 warm and 50 cold samples per arm per concurrency per rep). Candidate warm p50 is at or below control at c1 (468.4 vs 479.2 ms) and c8 (2185.4 vs 2345.6 ms), and c8 throughput is 3.196/s vs 3.215/s. Both arms show ~430 ms warm acceptedToDispatch, a paired rig cost that cancels. Cold acceptedToDispatch p50 is ~1.4 s for candidate vs ~0.4 s for control, but cold ingressToAccepted is ~0.1 s vs ~1.1 s the other way: ingress+dispatch sums are 1540 vs 1508 ms at c1 and 1687 vs 1714 ms at c8, so one ~1.1 s cold first-use cost lands in a different phase per arm and is not candidate overhead [inferred: paid at work_items:create by control and between submit and claim by candidate; no DBOS queue is on this path].
